Symmetrizing the triangular vertical separation yields independent W Uniform[0,H/2], and an exact coupling of Klein and torus distances. Integration gives the CDF gap, its strict support and both diameters. Elementary rescaling with dominated convergence yields 3/2 onset and quadratic versus cubic upper-tail exponents with finite positive exact constants for all L,H>0. The standalone verifier passed 5,656 exact finite and 49 deterministic numerical checks, supplemental only.

value.rationale: The problem naturally compares intrinsic distances on the two flat surfaces formed by twisted and untwisted gluing of a single rectangle, at the same area and diameter. A complete stochastic order controls every increasing distance functional, while the exact half-vertical-period transition and sharp 3/2, 2, and 3 exponents reveal global versus extreme-distance effects of nonorientability. The result is structurally general for every positive aspect ratio, not an arbitrary isolated sample or a routine moment calculation.
